items.title: Cascadu interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, November 15, 2019
items.q: Through Jon, he and Herbie Hancock came off the plane together. I didn’t know these guys were buddies.

ctx.x: town. If you saw it, right, because it had passed already. He’s got to be in town. And I looked up and I saw he was at the Blue Note. I hauled my butt down to the Blue Note that night man, and I went to the Blue Note, and I got there early, super early. I was one of the first people getting into the Blue Note. And Jon came onto the stage, this frail guy man. This frail guy. And I’m looking at him and I’m like this is the man, this is the moment I waited for and that band kicked off [scats] and his pipes came out,…

in that embrace. And he, after, he said, “So what you do my son?” I said, “Well I’m a musician, I’m a percussionist” etcetera. He says, “Well look,” he gave me his card. He said “I’m going back to” he was living in Puerto Rico at the time and he says, “I’m going back in three days. Call me.” I said okay. In three days I called Jon. From that day anytime Jon came to New York he would call me and I would go and pick him up at the airport. I would carry his guitar. I would carry his guitar. Through Jon, he and…
I have three in my basement.
